question: what does ramapo's computer science major page say about careers after graduating, and who does it say to contact with questions?
answer:
Ramapo’s Computer Science major page says the career prospects for students with a Computer Science degree are “wide-ranging and bright,” and specifically points to areas such as software development, robotics, big data, financial modeling, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. The Computer Science BS catalog description adds that graduates have opportunities in business, government, and academia, and says recent graduates have gone into software development, project management, research, marketing, database development and administration, financial engineering, cybersecurity, data mining, systems administration, quality assurance, education, game development, management, consulting, and sales. It also says graduates often continue to graduate school while pursuing their careers. [Majors, Minors & Concentrations](https://www.ramapo.edu/majors-minors/majors/computer-science/) [Ramapo Programs](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-CMPS)

The page I found specifically says to email Scott Frees at sfrees@ramapo.edu for information on the 4+1 program. The published Computer Science BS program convener is also Scott Frees. [Majors, Minors & Concentrations](https://www.ramapo.edu/majors-minors/majors/computer-science/) [Ramapo Programs](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-CMPS)

I did not retrieve a separate line on the major page that explicitly says “contact this person with questions” for the major overall; the clearly stated contact I found on that page is Scott Frees for 4+1 information. [Majors, Minors & Concentrations](https://www.ramapo.edu/majors-minors/majors/computer-science/)
